purpose: Teach: 取りあえず/なかには/ちらほら/うかがっ/食え/何れ/ほったらかし/大概

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、取りあえず新メニューを試作してみましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's go ahead and test out the new menu items.
lines.style: Direct, purposeful delivery. Quick attack on the opening name. Warm underneath — inviting her into the project, not commanding it. Steady pace, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様のなかには、毎日お見えになる方もいらっしゃるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, Aoi, some of our customers come in every single day.
lines.style: Gentle observation, slightly wondering. Soft, conversational rhythm. A small smile in the voice — noticing something lovely about consistency. Trails off slightly at the end, reflective.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューの注文、ちらほら入ってきたわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, we've been getting orders for the new menu items trickling in.
lines.style: Pleased but measured delivery. Light, almost musical lilt on 'trickling in.' Warm tone — she's pleased but not triumphant. Steady pace, grounded.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お友達のお話をうかがってらしたわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, one of our customers was telling her friend about us.
lines.style: Soft, almost touched quality. Quiet realization in the voice. Slow, careful pace — she's letting the moment breathe. Wondering, grateful.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、食えるだけ食べていらっしゃったわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer ate nearly everything we put in front of her.
lines.style: Dry affection underneath the wry surface. Gentle laugh ready in the background. Warm but knowing — she's seen this before. Light, easy pace.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、何れまた、お店の改装も考えましょうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, maybe down the line we should think about renovating the shop.
lines.style: Thoughtful, gently planning. Quiet, conversational tone. She's not pushing — it's a suggestion for someday. Slow, easy pace, trailing off with possibility.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、棚の整理をほったらかしにしてしまったわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, we really did let the shelves get away from us, didn't we?
lines.style: Rueful but not upset. Light self-deprecating humor. Soft pace, with a tiny sigh underneath. She's noticing their own lapse together, not blaming.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、大概、午後にお見えになるよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, Aoi, most of them do tend to come by in the afternoon.
lines.style: Quiet, observant close. Gentle rhythm, reflective but not melancholy. A small knowing pause before the closing. Fading softly at the end.
